quotes.text: Change set 01M6MM3 serves milestone-25 ... Every place the build, review and plan-review guides show `rhiza run findings ... <file>` or `rhiza run verdict ... <file>` switches to the stdin heredoc form ... No CLI change: both commands already accept `-`.

fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present, so no owner words are quoted. The change set's intent: agents in runs hit Claude Code permission prompts when recording findings, because the build, review and plan-review guides show `rhiza run findings <file>`, so agents write mktemp-and-echo shell one-liners. The planner found both `rhiza run findings` and `rhiza run verdict` already read `-` as stdin (readReviewFile, internal/api/run_review.go). One combined question went to the arbiter (intent, scope, acceptance); its ruling stdin-guides-ruling: serve milestone-25; switch every findings and verdict `<file>` in the three guides to the stdin heredoc form `- <<'EOF'`, keeping flags and JSON shapes; no CLI change; `rhiza apply <file>` stays as is; test through internal/guide's build, review and plan tests. Planned: one leaf, guides-stdin-findings, under built-in-workflows. Nothing left open.
fields.title: Plan: guides show stdin form for run findings and verdicts (autonomous)
